results.title: Collector’s report flags violations at Catholic Gym
results.description: MUMBAI: The Mumbai City Collector has submitted an inquiry report to the state government on alleged violations of lease conditions by the Catholic Gymkhana on prime land at South Mumbai’s Marine Drive

results.title: Abdul El-Sayed disavows Muslim Brotherhood and criticizes implications that he has ‘dual loyalty’
results.description: Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed on Saturday disavowed the Muslim Brotherhood, an Islamist political movement, during a heated exchange at a town hall.

results.title: ‘She knew of proceedings, ED didn’t mislead court’: Priti Choksi loses plea to cancel warrant
results.description: MUMBAI: A special PMLA court has rejected two applications by Priti Choksi, wife of fugitive diamantaire Mehul Choksi, seeking cancellation of a bailable warrant issued against her in the Enforcement Directorate’s (ED) money-laundering case linked to the ₹13,000-crore Punjab National Bank (PNB) fraud
